contradicting_evidence: The bearish evidence is substantial enough to challenge a neutral assessment: only 13% of the breadth universe advanced, and every observed large- and mid-alt proxy constituent declined over 24h.
Conversely, later BTC and ETH spot prices are above the earlier morning snapshots, with positive latest-hour returns and taker-buy shares above one-half; a further rebound is plausible.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Rebound extension and renewed selling are both credible over the next 12h. BTC/ETH show price repair, but the supplied observations cannot establish whether that repair will persist or spread to altcoins. No defensible net directional advantage is established.
falsification_conditions: Successive observations showing sustained BTC/ETH gains, persistent ETH/BTC strength, and improving large- and mid-alt participation would resolve the uncertainty toward UP.
Repeated rebound failures followed by renewed price declines and fresh broad weakness would resolve the uncertainty toward DOWN.
missing_evidence: Price, order-flow, and breadth updates after the latest completed candle.
Evidence that the rebound persists beyond one positive hourly price/OI observation and is supported by sustained spot demand.
supporting_evidence: The latest hour shows BTC up approximately 0.38%, ETH up 0.50%, and ETH/BTC up 0.14%, indicating local improvement rather than uninterrupted selling.
That improvement conflicts with the earlier breadth snapshot: a roughly -4.95% median 24h return and zero advancing constituents in the large- and mid-alt proxies.

Earlier microstructure showed negative taker imbalance for both BTC and ETH, while later hourly taker-buy shares were positive. This demonstrates changing conditions, not a confirmed persistent demand regime.
